summary: Read one singly linked chain and a positive integer k, where k is no larger than the node total. From the head, each time a full block of k nodes is available, turn the links of that whole block around. Nodes left at the tail in a block shorter than k keep their original direction. Extra storage may stay only at a fixed size. Integers inside nodes must not be altered. Write the head when processing finishes.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
